quest.title: Blocked?
quest.description: Myrana was enjoying a rare opportunity to go out for a walk, but on the way to the winery is stopped and attacked by hilichurls. Defeat the hilichurls and save Myrana.

dialogues.speaker: Panicked Myrana
dialogues.text: *sigh* First monsters, now this roadblock... It's hectic enough already back home, there was me thinking this would be a chance to get away from it all for a while!

dialogues.speaker: Panicked Myrana
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, but is there any chance you could sort out this roadblock situation for me?

response.speaker: Panicked Myrana
response.text: Thank you! I hope my two young ones grow up to be kind like you.

choices.text: I have other things to do.

response.speaker: Panicked Myrana
response.text: Come on, please... I promise it won't take you too long.

talks.objective: Defeat all opponents and destroy the roadblocks

dialogues.speaker: Panicked Myrana
dialogues.text: But please, don't tell anybody I got myself into trouble. My husband will give me an earful if he finds out...

dialogues.speaker: Panicked Myrana
dialogues.text: Don't look at me like that... Wait till you're married, you'll see. A solitary stroll is a huge luxury when you're living with someone, you've got to make the most of it.

dialogues.speaker: Panicked Myrana
dialogues.text: Here, take this. I picked some while I was out. Much cheaper to cook for yourself than eat at Good Hunter! You have to scrimp and save if you want to get by.
